profile.name: Rafael P. Ramos
profile.title: Senior Android Engineer | Kotlin, Java, Architecture & Security
profile.bio: Senior Android Engineer with over 10 years of experience building mission-critical mobile applications across the financial services, automotive, and e-commerce industries. Specialized in Kotlin, Java, mobile architecture, concurrency, security, authentication, session management, real-time communication, performance, and SDK and service integration. Experienced across the full Android delivery lifecycle, from implementation and testing to Google Play releases, platform evolution, failure investigation, and security remediation.
profile.interests: Android and Android Automotive, Kotlin, Java, mobile architecture, concurrency, application security, authentication and identity, session management, performance, observability, offline resilience, and code maintainability.
strengths: Android development with Kotlin and Java
Architecture and evolution of mission-critical mobile applications
Mobile security, authentication, and data protection
Session management and secure inter-app communication
Build systems, compatibility, testing, and Google Play releases

experience.companyDescription: ASA Investments — Multi-family office and asset manager focused on high-net-worth clients
highlights: Designed, prototyped, and developed the core Brokerage/Home Broker module, integrating the application with Nelogica infrastructure through WebView and APIs for real-time trading on B3.
Implemented a financial dashboard with multiple simultaneous charts, dynamic lists, on-demand pagination, and local search.
Structured state management with Bloc/Cubit to isolate UI updates, maintain predictable flows, and reduce unnecessary rebuilds.
Performed code reviews focused on memory management, declarative UI lifecycle, and controlled state mutation.
Worked on Volvo Cars' in-house infotainment platform based on Android Automotive OS (AAOS).
Implemented and maintained components across the ICUP, SPA1, SPA2, and SPA3 platforms, covering the DHU 1.1, IHU 4.0, and memory-enhanced DHU 2.0 architectures.
Developed integrations in the main Java layer and SystemUI components in Kotlin, following AAOS interface patterns including Panels and Scalable UI.
Added unit tests for code changes to reduce regressions and preserve stability across different platforms.
Investigated failures through Android bugreports by correlating logs from the application, framework, system, and hardware layers.
Documented fixes, defects, and technical evidence in Jira throughout the investigation and delivery lifecycle.

Served as the primary Android technical reference for a team of nine engineers during the product's transition into maintenance and continuous evolution, reviewing new solutions and preserving the principles of the foundational architecture.
Acted as a technical gatekeeper through pull request reviews, identifying architectural deviations, maintainability risks, and implementation issues before changes were merged.

Technically coordinated the Android release lifecycle, including Gitflow organization, Android App Bundle generation, release preparation, and Google Play submission. Handled review requirements such as test credentials and instructions, store listing updates, content and privacy declarations, target SDK compatibility, and remediation requests from the platform.

Served as the security-focused mobile engineer in partnership with the Red Team, reviewing assessment findings and implementing remediations such as screenshot blocking for sensitive flows, encryption of data persisted on disk, and stronger security layers between the application and backend services.

Developed transaction, offshore investment, foreign exchange, and authentication journeys, translating UX specifications into Android screens, navigation, backend model and endpoint integrations, unit tests, and instrumented tests.

Designed and implemented a WebSocket stack on top of OkHttp for a proprietary protocol. Partnered with the Equities team to map the communication flow and enable real-time stock listing and updates within the application.
Evolved the login and session stack, including client-side configuration and token-sharing flows across BTG applications using native Android mechanisms such as BroadcastReceiver and ContentProvider.

Built an internal diagnostic tool exposed through a floating bubble and backed by a reflection-based configuration center. The tool enabled REST request inspection—including status codes, payloads, and headers—notification and deep-link testing, and runtime switching of white-label configurations.

Maintained the Android-specific platform layer, leading upgrades of native SDKs, Android Gradle Plugin, Gradle, and Kotlin, while resolving compatibility issues, build failures, and bottlenecks affecting the team's development workflow.

Supported technical evolution initiatives beyond the main product flow, including mobile test automation with Appium and the development and distribution of reusable SDKs to other mobile teams across the bank.
Defined and evolved the BTG Investimentos application's architecture based on Android platform recommendations, prioritizing separation of concerns and maintainability.
Implemented push notifications, deep links, and analytics, connecting application journeys to external services and measurement mechanisms.
Optimized Gradle scripts and configuration to reduce build times and improve the local development cycle.
Integrated a facial recognition SDK into mobile flows, addressing its incorporation into the existing architecture and user journeys.
Developed the core Trade Marketing module and integrated it into the company's proprietary Server-Driven UI engine.
Contributed to the design and development of the Server-Driven UI SDK, creating reusable and configurable Custom Views from scratch.
Led the technical certification and rollout of the new architectural ecosystem for the solution's first enterprise client.
Applied SOLID principles, Clean Architecture, and componentization to reduce coupling and increase code reuse across multiple tenants.
Contributed to the adoption of MVVM in Android features, reinforcing separation between UI, state, and application logic.
Implemented asynchronous processing for intensive tasks using Java's Executor API.
Integrated facial recognition and document OCR SDKs into application journeys.
Contributed to the development of a proprietary Server-Driven UI SDK for Android applications.
Developed custom, reusable UI components from scratch.
Supported the international rollout of the solution for the company's first client in Mexico.
Implemented features and fixes for mobile solutions, building a foundation in Android development and software delivery.
